notes: Citus coordinator + 5 worker primaries + 5 streaming replicas (registered as Citus secondary nodes), every PostgreSQL instance limited to 0.8 CPU / 1.5 GiB. Clients enter through HAProxy -> 3 PgBouncer instances (transaction pooling) -> coordinator. Tables are hash-distributed (customers/orders/events by customer_id, order_items by order_id, inventory by product_id); products and categories are reference tables. Manual worker failover = promote replica + citus_update_node().
